name: bubble
useFor: Use for the lines of an agent conversation, inside Message. Use default for the agent's own messages (align end), secondary for the person or store it talks to, tinted for another agent, muted for a system line, destructive for a message that failed. Group consecutive bubbles in BubbleGroup.
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the blue key, the window edge and mist, 12px window corners)
